svg.title: Kansai Rail Pass Decision Tree: JR Passes, Osaka Amazing Pass, KANSAI RAILWAY PASS LITE, Day Passes, or ICOCA
svg.desc: Two questions, eight outcomes. Question 1: Does your itinerary leave central Osaka or Kyoto? If no, go to Question 2 (how many rides and paid sights per day): 4+ Osaka Metro rides on weekdays or 3+ on weekends/holidays -> Osaka Metro Enjoy Eco Card (¥820 weekdays, ¥620 weekends/holidays); 3+ paid Osaka attractions in one day -> Osaka Amazing Pass (1-day ¥3,500, 2-day ¥5,000, ~40 free attractions); 5+ rides on a Kyoto bus day -> Kyoto Subway & Bus 1-Day Pass (¥1,100; City Bus flat fare ¥230); none of the above (only 2–3 rides/day) -> skip passes and tap ICOCA (visitor edition ¥2,000 including ¥500 deposit). If yes, go to Question 3 (JR or private rail, and how far): visiting Okayama, Kurashiki, Kinosaki Onsen, or Shirahama within 5 days -> JR West Kansai Wide Area Pass (5-day ¥12,000, includes Shin-Osaka–Okayama Shinkansen reserved seats plus HARUKA, Kuroshio, and Kounotori); riding HARUKA from KIX plus consecutive JR days to Kobe, Himeji, or Nara -> JR West Kansai Area Pass (1-day ¥2,800, 2-day ¥4,800, 3-day ¥5,800, 4-day ¥7,000; 2 HARUKA reserved seats; excludes Shinkansen and other limited express trains); 2–3 days across Osaka, Kyoto, Nara, and Kobe on private rail only -> KANSAI RAILWAY PASS LITE (2-day ¥5,200, 3-day ¥6,500; excludes JR, Kyoto Subway, and buses; sold online only via Klook, KKday, WAUG, and Trip.com); same-day round-trip on a single private line -> single-line day pass (Hankyu ¥1,300, Hankyu Hanshin ¥1,600, Keihan ¥1,650, Kintetsu ¥1,900). Adult fares in JPY verified on official websites in September 2026; LITE is the October 2026 edition verified October 5, 2026, and must be activated by March 31, 2027.
svg.text: Which Kansai Rail Pass to Buy: Two Questions, Eight Outcomes (Sep 2026 Fares)
JR West passes, Osaka Amazing Pass, KANSAI RAILWAY PASS LITE, single-line day passes, or pay-as-you-go ICOCA
Q1: Leaving central Osaka or Kyoto?
Kobe, Nara, Himeji, Wakayama, Okayama, Kinosaki, Shirahama
No · Staying in central Osaka or Kyoto
Yes · Kobe, Nara, Himeji, or farther
Q2: In town — how many rides or sights/day?
Subway rides, paid attractions, or Kyoto bus rides
Osaka Metro: 4+ rides on weekdays, 3+ on weekends/holidays
Enjoy Eco Card · ¥820 weekday / ¥620 weekend & holiday
Sold at subway machines; unlimited Osaka Metro (excl. Yumeshima) & City Bus
3+ paid Osaka attractions in a single day
Osaka Amazing Pass · 1-Day ¥3,500 / 2-Day ¥5,000
~40 free attractions plus Osaka Metro & designated city private rail
Kyoto bus-heavy day: 5+ rides in one day
Kyoto Subway & Bus 1-Day Pass · ¥1,100
City Bus flat fare ¥230/ride; excludes JR, Keihan, Hankyu & Randen
None of the above: only 2–3 rides a day
Skip passes — tap ICOCA pay-as-you-go
Visitor edition ¥2,000 (incl. ¥500 deposit) at KIX JR ticket office
Q3: Day trips — JR or private rail, how far?
Riding HARUKA from KIX usually points to JR
Visiting Okayama, Kurashiki, Kinosaki Onsen, or Shirahama in 5 days
JR West Kansai Wide Area Pass · 5-Day ¥12,000
Includes Shin-Osaka–Okayama Shinkansen, HARUKA, Kuroshio & Kounotori
HARUKA from KIX + consecutive JR days to Kobe, Himeji & Nara
JR West Kansai Area Pass · 1D ¥2,800 · 2D ¥4,800 · 3D ¥5,800 · 4D ¥7,000
2 HARUKA reserved seats; no Shinkansen or other limited express; consecutive days
2–3 days across Osaka, Kyoto, Nara & Kobe on private rail only
KANSAI RAILWAY PASS LITE · 2-Day ¥5,200 / 3-Day ¥6,500
Excludes JR, Kyoto Subway & buses; online only (Klook, KKday, WAUG, Trip.com)
Same-day round-trip on a single private railway
Hankyu ¥1,300 · Hankyu Hanshin ¥1,600 · Keihan ¥1,650 · Kintetsu ¥1,900
Digital QR passes; Kintetsu Limited Express requires a separate surcharge
Adult fares in JPY, verified on official sites in Sep 2026; LITE is the Oct 2026 edition (verified Oct 5, 2026; activate by Mar 31, 2027).
